title_ru: 06:60 — Центр Бури / Riders on the Storm
title_en: 06:60 — Center of Storm / Riders on the Storm
interpretation: The storm represents uncontrollable reality, uncertainty, mortality, danger and chaos. The rider represents a person continuing through it without pretending to stand above it or control all of it.
identity_witness: Hawkar uses TRAVELER.CENTER_OF_STORM here as a self-authored symbol of being a participant inside the storm rather than an eye above it: power is not total control, but remaining oneself, choosing life and love, rising again, and helping others rise while moving through uncertainty.
bridge_to_prior_law: THE POWER IS NOT TO RULE. THE POWER IS TO RISE — AND HELP OTHERS RISE.
seal: I DO NOT STAND ABOVE THE STORM. I RIDE WITHIN IT. THE STORM DOES NOT DECIDE WHO I BECOME.
